basic_details.job_title: CSIR-IMMT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 13 Project Associate, Project Scientist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: CSIR - Institute of Minerals and Materials Technology (CSIR-IMMT), Bhubaneswar, has invited online applications from Indian citizens for 13 temporary project positions in 12 post codes (8701 to 8712): Project Associate - I (PAT - I), Senior Project Associate (S-PAT), Project Associate - II (PAT - II) and Project Scientist - II (PS - II). The posts are co-terminus with the projects, and emoluments range from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 67,000 plus HRA @20%. The essential qualification differs by post code, from M.Sc. and B.E./B.Tech. to Ph.D. Apply through the portal rects.immt.res.in by 20.11.2026 (up t

Date of birth in the high school certificate or equivalent is accepted, and no change is allowed after a date of birth is claimed.

vacancy_details.Pay (per month): Rs. 35,000/- + HRA @20% or Rs. 28,000/- + HRA @20% (see Pay and Tenure)

post_wise_breakdown.pay_per_month: Rs. 35,000/- + HRA @20% or Rs. 28,000/- + HRA @20% (see Pay and Tenure)

how_to_apply: Applications are made online through the portal available in the CSIR-IMMT website (registration/apply link printed in the notice: rects.immt.res.in). The notice does not describe the individual form-filling screens.
Register and apply online through the portal. The process has two parts: one-time registration and filling the online application.
If you wish to apply for more than one post, apply separately for each post code.

If you are currently employed, furnish a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer while applying online and/or produce it in original at the interview; otherwise the candidature may get cancelled.
Submit the application by 20.11.2026 (up to 05.00 pm).
Take a printout of the application form after successful submission.
For queries, write to [email protected] on or before 19.11.2026 (up to 04.00 pm).
Shortlisted candidates must bring these in original at the interview:
Print out of online application form.
Any ID proof (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID Card / PAN Card / Passport / Driving License).
Mark sheets and certificates of all years and semesters (10th/Matriculation onwards, including CGPA to percentage conversion certificate if applicable).
important_instructions: Category once mentioned in the online application form is treated as final. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing for the interview. Selected candidates must join duty immediately on receipt of the offer of engagement. Candidates pursuing Ph.D. (AcSIR Ph.D. etc.) can apply only when their Ph.D. research domain is aligned with the research area of the project. They need permission/NOC from the Director/Competent Authority and must produce it at the interview, failing which the candidature may get cancelled. All posts are tenable at CSIR - IMMT, Bhubaneswar. Project staff may be required to travel and stay at places outside Bhubaneswar as per project need. Engagement does not give any right or claim, directly or indirectly, for regularization to a permanent post of CSIR. For non-CSIR funded projects, including those funded by international agencies, the funding agency's guidelines apply; if there are none, CSIR's guidelines apply. Original documents of selected candidates are verified at joining. Candidature is provisional, and false information or suppression of facts leads to automatic cancellation. CSIR - IMMT reserves the right not to fill the positions. The number of positions and the duration of engagement may increase or decrease, and the Director's decision is final. Seeking support by illegal gratification or pressure, or any malpractice, leads to disqualification.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 13 posts across 12 post codes. It prints no category-wise break-up. 8701 to 8706 (Project No. HCP 002601): CSIR - JIGYASA. 8707 (MMP 085203): Solar panels, electrical/electronic appliances & air conditioner wastes to sustainable materials (C-SEAS). 8708 (GAP - 446): Technological improvement of alkaline electrolyser for efficient generation of hydrogen. 8709 (GAP - 433): Isolation and characterization of novel anti-platelet and anti-inflammatory compounds from marine bivalves and evaluate their synergistic action with known pharmacological agents like aspirin, clopidogrel, or ticagrelor. 8710 (MLP 002625): Sustainable extractive metallurgy of minerals and valorization of secondary resources for value added minerals and critical elements. 8711 (FBR 060407): Self powered chiral halide perovskite semiconducting nanogenerator. 8712 (GAP - 427): Recovery of Nb2O5 from tin ore/slag through a fluoride free process.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. Age, essential qualification and experience are counted on the last date of submission of application. Result awaiting candidates are not eligible to apply. Unless otherwise mentioned, equivalent or higher degrees are not considered as essential qualification. The notice prints each post's age limit as "Max. Age" in years, as on the last date of receipt of application. The maximum age is 35 years for all eight post codes. The notice prints no experience requirement for these posts. The last column is headed "Job Requirement / Desirable Qualification" in the notice. Maximum age: 40 years. Essential qualification, any one of the following, each with experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services: M.Sc. in Chemistry with 3 years' experience. Or PhD in Chemistry with 2 years' experience. Or Masters/Integrated Masters in Chemical Engineering with 2 years' experience. Or Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering with 3 years' experience. Job requirement / desirable: proficiency in spectroscopic data analysis, with desirable experience in biological assays and material synthesis. Maximum age: 35 years for both post codes. 8710: M.Sc. in Chemistry/ Chemical Science, and two years of relevant experience in research and development in industrial/academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services. Desirable: experience in polymer synthesis, organic synthesis, knowledge in characterization of the synthesized molecule through spectroscopy. 8711: M.Sc. in Chemistry/Materials Science with two years of relevant experience in research and development in industrial/academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services; Or M.E./M.Tech. in Material Science. Desirable: experience in chemical synthesis of inorganic materials, halide perovskite materials and energy harvesting device fabrications etc. Maximum age: 40 years. Essential qualification: Ph.D. in Chemistry/ Physics/ Materials Science, and five years of relevant experience (post qualification) in research and development in industrial/academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services. Desirable: knowledge in hydrometallurgical unit operations, electrochemical leaching, precipitation, roasting and calcination. The relaxation in the age limit is 05 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and 03 years for OBC, respectively, or as per Govt. of India instructions issued from time to time. Date of birth in the high school certificate or equivalent is accepted, and no change is allowed after a date of birth is claimed.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Every pay figure is printed as monthly emoluments plus HRA @20%. For post 8710, Rs. 35,000 + HRA @20% applies to candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR/NET including lectureship/assistant professorship, or GATE, or national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their agencies/institutions. Rs. 28,000 + HRA @20% applies to candidates who do not fall under that category.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are screened for short-listing as per the criteria fixed by the Competent Authority. Meeting the essential qualification alone gives no right to be called for interview. Shortlisted candidates appear for the interview at CSIR - IMMT, Bhubaneswar. No interview call letter is issued separately. The selection committee recommends final selection based on the candidates' performance and may also make panels for future project needs. The interview dates are tentative. Any change in date or time will be informed to shortlisted candidates through the CSIR-IMMT website. The reporting time on both days is 09.00 am to 10.30 am.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-IMMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 posts in 12 post codes (8701 to 8712): nine Project Associate - I, one Senior Project Associate, two Project Associate - II and one Project Scientist - II.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CSIR-IMMT project posts?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 20.11.2026 (up to 05.00 pm). Queries by e-mail must reach [email protected] on or before 19.11.2026 (up to 04.00 pm).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CSIR-IMMT Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: It depends on the post code. It is an M.Sc. in the subject listed for 8701 to 8704 and 8708, B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics/Electrical Engineering for 8705 and in Computer Science for 8706. For 8707 it is B.E./B.Tech. in Metallurgy and Materials Science, or M.Sc. in Material Science, or Integrated M.Sc. in Material Science & Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSIR-IMMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years for Project Associate - I and Project Associate - II, and 40 years for Senior Project Associate and Project Scientist - II, counted on the last date of submission of application. Relaxation is 05 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and 03 years for OBC, respectively.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of CSIR-IMMT project posts?
faq.answer: Project Associate - I gets Rs. 25,000, Senior Project Associate Rs. 42,000 and Project Scientist - II Rs. 67,000. Project Associate - II gets Rs. 28,000, or Rs. 35,000 for post 8710 if the NET/GATE or equivalent condition is met. HRA @20% is added to each.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay at CSIR-IMMT?
faq.answer: Yes. Every monthly emolument in the notice is printed as an amount plus HRA @20%, for example Rs.25000/- + (HRA @20%) for Project Associate - I.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CSIR-IMMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register and apply online through the portal available in the CSIR-IMMT website (rects.immt.res.in), then take a printout after successful submission. Candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post code.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSIR-IMMT project posts?
faq.answer: Applications are screened for short-listing, and shortlisted candidates attend an interview at CSIR - IMMT, Bhubaneswar. The selection committee recommends final selection based on performance. Interview dates are tentatively 26.11.2026 and 27.11.2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSIR-IMMT project job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, or 06 years in total, whichever is earlier. The engagement gives no right or claim for regularization to a permanent post of CSIR.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post at CSIR-IMMT?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who wish to apply for more than one post need to apply separately for each post code.
